title: The Hidden Faith Within the Palace Walls
intro: In the center of a tyrannical court filled with plots and pride, a lone soul holds a dangerous secret. Surrounded by power and threats of death, this servant of Allah watches a messenger stand alone against an empire. When silence becomes complicity, a bold decision must be made to speak truth at great personal risk.
clues: I lived among a powerful and arrogant people who rejected the signs of Allah.
I concealed my faith for a time while those around me plotted against a messenger.
I spoke out openly, saying: Do you kill an individual because they say, My Lord is Allah, while clear proofs have come?
I warned my people about the fate of earlier nations and about a Day of Mutual Calling.
I told them that the ruler I served shows only narrow opinion, yet the Hereafter is the true home.
I said: O my people, follow me and I will guide you to the right path, and Allah saved me from the evil of their plotting.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Abu Lahab
Qarun
As-Samiri
Haman
The Believer from Pharaoh's Family

trial.label: What Did I Do?
options: Amassed treasures whose keys burdened strong men
Built a lofty tower to look at the god of Musa
Concealed faith then openly defended Musa and warned my people
Fashioned a golden calf that made a lowing sound
Blocked the Prophet's path and mocked revelation for wealth
trial.answer: Concealed faith then openly defended Musa and warned my people

location.label: Where Did My Story Unfold?
options: The Ark upon the flood waters
The Sacred Mosque in Makkah
Pharaoh's Palace Court in Egypt
The Cave of the Sleepers
The Wooded Valley of Madyan

outcome.label: What Was My Outcome?
options: I drowned with the army in the divided sea
The earth swallowed me with my treasures
A thunderbolt seized me with Thamud
I was turned into an ape for breaking the Sabbath
Allah protected me from the evil of their plot
outcome.answer: Allah protected me from the evil of their plot

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
